sentences.en: There is a constant perception of carnal joy as spiritual.
sentences.zh: 有一种持续将肉欲之乐视为精神之乐的看法。

sentences.en: The simple perception of natural forms is a delight.
sentences.zh: 单纯地感受自然形态本身就是一种乐趣。

sentences.en: It is hard, perhaps even impossible, to define normal sensory perception.
sentences.zh: 要定义正常的感官感觉可能很难，甚至不可能。

senses.zh: 感知(能力)；觉察(力) - 认识，观念，看法 形容词: perceptional
